title: SkillCommit: Evolving Agent Skills through Behaviorally Validated Scope Expansion
abstract: arXiv:2608.15165v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can continually improve without parameter updates by converting historical experience into reusable procedural knowledge. However, existing methods often consolidate experience based on semantic similarity or LLM judgments, which may merge superficially related but behaviorally incompatible strategies and thereby degrade performance. To address the issue, we propose SkillCommit, an online skill evolution framework that continuously transforms experience into a hierarchical library of reusable skills. Each new experience is initially preserved as an instance-specific patch, retaining the behavior validated in its local context. As related skills accumulate, SkillCommit abstracts those sharing a common behavioral mechanism into higher-level skills. translated_title: SkillCommit：通过行为验证的范围扩展进化智能体技能
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15165v1 公告类型：新论文  摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）智能体可以通过将历史经验转化为可重用的程序性知识，无需参数更新即可持续改进。然而，现有方法通常基于语义相似性或LLM判断来整合经验，这可能会合并表面相关但行为不兼容的策略，从而降低性能。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SkillCommit，一种在线技能进化框架，将经验持续转化为分层可重用技能库。每个新经验最初被保留为实例特定的补丁，保留其局部上下文中验证过的行为。随着相关技能的积累，SkillCommit将那些共享共同行为机制的技能抽象为更高级别的技能。具体而言，对于每个传入技能，基于嵌入的检索首先识别候选相关技能。跨实例重放和基于LLM的机制用于验证行为兼容性，仅当确认行为一致性时才允许技能合并或抽象。
tldr: 提出了SkillCommit框架，通过行为验证的范围扩展，将经验分层抽象为可重用技能，避免合并行为不兼容的策略，从而提升LLM智能体的持续学习性能。
en_tdlr: SkillCommit proposes an online skill evolution framework that hierarchically abstracts validated experiences through behaviorally compatible scope expansion, preventing performance degradation from merging incompatible strategies.
